metadata.description: dolaramp's skills for building stablecoin payment gateways with Claude.

plugins.name: dolaramp
plugins.description: Build a stablecoin payment gateway with Claude. Accept USDT, USDC and PYUSD, pay out, and reconcile on Solana, TRON, TON, Base and Arbitrum through the dolaramp API: deposit addresses per customer, signed webhooks, gasless sweeps and payouts, USDT on TRON without TRX, USDC bridging.
